chars.NARRATOR: a young Moroccan woman about 25, long dark wavy hair loose, mustard-yellow chunky knit sweater, light blue jeans, small gold hoop earrings
chars.AUNT: a young Moroccan woman about 22, black hair in a high ponytail, emerald-green satin blouse, white wide-leg trousers, thin gold necklace
chars.MAN: a European man about 38, short light-brown hair, neat short beard, navy blazer over a plain white t-shirt, beige chinos

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from across a cafe table on a sunny terrace in Rabat: AUNT leans in laughing shyly at something MAN says, MAN smiles at her warmly, mint tea glasses and pastries on the table; head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, playful slightly awkward mood. 2D animated illustration, vertical, no text

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: The three walk side by side along the Rabat corniche by the ocean in late afternoon, NARRATOR in the middle gesturing to include AUNT in the conversation, AUNT laughing, MAN looking past NARRATOR at AUNT; cheerful mood, Moroccan seaside promenade. 2D animated illustration, vertical, no text

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Earlier, in a cosy Moroccan living room with patterned cushions, NARRATOR sits beside AUNT like a big sister, pointing at an open notebook teaching her English, AUNT concentrating and smiling; warm lamp light, faces visible. 2D animated illustration, vertical, no text

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, NARRATOR back home sitting on her bed in a Moroccan bedroom, still happy from the outing, her phone lighting up with a new message in her hand, her smile freezing into a worried frown; head-to-waist framing, face visible. 2D animated illustration, vertical, no text, phone screen shows only a glow

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close view of NARRATOR on her bed at night holding the glowing phone with both hands, eyes wide with suspicion and dread, biting her lip, dim blue light on her face, the door of the room ajar behind her. 2D animated illustration, vertical, no text
